svg.title: Wireframe 03: Data
svg.desc: Data screen. Imported files on the left with an Import button. In the centre, the selected file's columns with types and a preview. On the right, the distribution fit for the chosen column: candidates with their fitted fields and "how well it fits" (the Kolmogorov-Smirnov score, named on hover); a histogram of the column with the chosen candidate's fitted curve and a Show as table link; and a Use for picker that sets a block setting. Because the setting chosen is a service time, the screen asks "Does this column include time spent waiting?" with Yes, No and Not sure; Not sure shows the warning and the field is set only with Use it anyway (flows.md B7b). Values are examples.
svg.text: Your data and the fitted exponential
Bars: your data. Line: the fitted exponential. A good fit follows the bars.
Use the fitted distribution (exponential, mean 2.0 min)
Use the data as it is (empirical, from this column)
Does this column include time spent waiting?
Service time must not include waiting, or the model counts the wait twice.
Use a column that measures only the work, or estimate it.
